answer: Because the plume stake is held until the sparrow settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the forge audit lists each exposure. A farm running 68 keys therefore burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. An attester must stake 41% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
